# Commands

Every change to a project is a command `{"op": ..., fields}`, run with `mgl edit <file> <op> [bare] k=v ...`, as JSON
(`mgl edit <file> '{"op": ...}'`, `--batch f.jsonl`) or from the SDK (`p.edit({op, ...})`). Times accept frames (75),
"2.5s", "1:02.5" and "00:01:02:15". `k=v` values are JSON when they parse, else strings. `mgl docs <op>` prints one entry.

78 commands: [asset](#asset) · [audio](#audio) · [captions](#captions) · [clip](#clip) · [comp](#comp) · [effects](#effects) · [project](#project) · [keyframes](#keyframes) · [layout](#layout) · [marker](#marker) · [masks](#masks) · [motion](#motion) · [recipes](#recipes) · [text](#text) · [templates](#templates) · [track](#track)

## asset

### asset.add

Add a media file (video, audio, image, font, LUT, subtitles) by path relative to the project; probes it.

fields: `src` string (bare word); `id?` string; `kind?` "video"\|"audio"\|"image"\|"font"\|"lut"\|"subtitles"\|"data"; `note?` string

```text
mgl edit video.mgl.json asset.add media/beach.mov id=beach
{"op":"asset.add","src":"media/beach.mov","id":"beach"}
```

### asset.relink

Point an asset at another file (e.g. after moving media).

fields: `id` string (bare word); `src` string

```text
mgl edit video.mgl.json asset.relink beach src=media/beach-v2.mov
{"op":"asset.relink","id":"beach","src":"media/beach-v2.mov"}
```

### asset.remove

Remove an asset; refuses while clips use it unless `clips: true` also removes them.

fields: `id` string (bare word); `clips?` boolean

```text
mgl edit video.mgl.json asset.remove beach
{"op":"asset.remove","id":"beach"}
```

## audio

### audio.auto-sfx

Place fitting generated SFX on a comp: whoosh on transitions, hit on hard cuts, swoosh on template entrances, pop on text entrances (on= picks the kinds; map={"text":"click","cuts":"none"} changes or disables them). Each is linked to its source clip so it moves with it; re-running replaces the previous auto SFX.

fields: `on?` ("transitions"\|"cuts"\|"templates"\|"text")[]; `map?` object; `gain?` number; `seed?` int; `comp?` string; `min?` time

```text
mgl edit video.mgl.json audio.auto-sfx on='["transitions","text"]' map='{"text":"pop"}'
{"op":"audio.auto-sfx","on":["transitions","text"],"map":{"text":"pop"}}
```

### audio.cut-silences

Find silences in a clip's audio (analysis) and ripple-remove them, keeping pad on each side; linked clips are cut together.

fields: `id` string (bare word); `min?` time; `pad?` time; `db?` number

```text
mgl edit video.mgl.json audio.cut-silences vo min=0.6s pad=0.15s db=-40
{"op":"audio.cut-silences","id":"vo","min":"0.6s","pad":"0.15s","db":-40}
```

### audio.duck

Duck one bus (default music) by db dB while another (default dialogue) has signal.

fields: `bus?` string; `by?` string; `db?` number; `attack?` number; `release?` number

```text
mgl edit video.mgl.json audio.duck bus=music by=dialogue db=9
{"op":"audio.duck","bus":"music","by":"dialogue","db":9}
```

### audio.fade

Fade a clip in and/or out (audio, and opacity for visuals); 0 removes a fade.

fields: `id` string (bare word); `in?` time; `out?` time

```text
mgl edit video.mgl.json audio.fade bed in=1s out=2s
{"op":"audio.fade","id":"bed","in":"1s","out":"2s"}
```

### audio.gain

Set a clip's gain in dB: a constant, or with at= a keyframe (clip-local time; abs=true: comp time).

fields: `id` string (bare word); `db` number; `at?` time; `abs?` boolean; `ease?` easing

```text
mgl edit video.mgl.json audio.gain bed db=-6
{"op":"audio.gain","id":"bed","db":-6}
```

### audio.music

Generate a music bed (offline, deterministic): mood upbeat|chill|dramatic|corporate|lofi|epic, optional bpm, key ("Am", "F# minor"), seed, intensity curve [[time, 0..1], ...] (times from the music start; layers enter as it rises) or energy 0..1, markers=beats|bars (exact grid markers); written to media/generated/ (reused when the parameters repeat), added as a looping clip on a music-bus track at -18 LUFS (re-running with the same id replaces it). marker.beats finds its beats.

fields: `len?` time; `mood?` "upbeat"\|"chill"\|"dramatic"\|"corporate"\|"lofi"\|"epic"\|"energetic"\|"driving"\|"calm"\|"happy"\|"cinematic"\|"tense"\|"relaxed"\|"business" (bare word); `bpm?` number; `key?` string; `seed?` int; `intensity?` [time, number][]; `energy?` number; `track?` string; `at?` time; `gain?` number; `id?` string; `comp?` string; `markers?` "beats"\|"bars"

```text
mgl edit video.mgl.json audio.music upbeat len=30s seed=1
{"op":"audio.music","mood":"upbeat","len":"30s","seed":1}
```

### audio.normalize

Set the loudness target of the mix (master bus), applied at render: lufs (default from the platform: -14 for shorts/tiktok/reels/youtube, else -16) and true-peak ceiling (default -1).

fields: `lufs?` number; `peak?` number

```text
mgl edit video.mgl.json audio.normalize lufs=-14
{"op":"audio.normalize","lufs":-14}
```

### audio.sfx

Add a generated sound effect (offline, deterministic, seedable) on an sfx-bus track: type whoosh|swoosh|pop|click|hit|impact|riser|ding|bell|swipe|glitch|typing|camera; at = the moment of the hit (a whoosh peaks there, a riser ends there); overlapping sounds go on extra sfx tracks; gain in dB.

fields: `type` "whoosh"\|"swoosh"\|"pop"\|"click"\|"hit"\|"impact"\|"riser"\|"ding"\|"bell"\|"swipe"\|"glitch"\|"typing"\|"camera" (bare word); `at` time; `gain?` number; `seed?` int; `track?` string; `id?` string; `comp?` string

```text
mgl edit video.mgl.json audio.sfx whoosh at=2s
{"op":"audio.sfx","type":"whoosh","at":"2s"}
```

### audio.speak

Text to speech through the project's speak provider (a plugin, e.g. flite-voice): writes media/generated/vo-<hash>.wav (reused when text, voice and speed repeat), adds it as an asset + clip on the dialogue bus (after the previous voice line unless at= is given), and stores word timings for captions.from-speech. voice and speed (0.5..2) are provider-specific; E_NO_PROVIDER when the project has none.

fields: `text` string (bare word); `voice?` string; `speed?` number; `track?` string; `at?` time; `id?` string; `comp?` string; `gain?` number

```text
mgl edit video.mgl.json audio.speak 'Three tips for better sleep.' voice=slt
{"op":"audio.speak","text":"Three tips for better sleep.","voice":"slt"}
```

### bus.add

Add an audio bus (dialogue, music, sfx and master exist without an entry); it feeds master unless to= says otherwise.

fields: `id` string (bare word); `to?` string; `gain?` number; `duck?` object

```text
mgl edit video.mgl.json bus.add vo2 to=dialogue gain=-3
{"op":"bus.add","id":"vo2","to":"dialogue","gain":-3}
```

### bus.set

Change a bus: gain (dB), muted, to, duck, loudness (master: {lufs, peak}); null removes a setting.

fields: `id` string (bare word); `gain?` number\|null; `muted?` boolean; `to?` string\|null; `duck?` object\|null; `loudness?` object\|null

```text
mgl edit video.mgl.json bus.set music gain=-8
{"op":"bus.set","id":"music","gain":-8}
```

## captions

### captions.from-speech

Word-timed caption cues from voice clips (clip=, clips=[...], or by default every voice clip on the dialogue bus, into one captions clip): uses the timings audio.speak stored, else the project's transcribe provider (a plugin), else (clips made by audio.speak) estimates them from the text. Cues of at most maxWords words (default 4) break at sentences, commas and pauses. Fills `id` (a captions clip, cues replaced) or creates one. E_NO_PROVIDER when nothing can time the words (fallback: captions.from-text voice=<clip> text=...).

fields: `clip?` string (bare word); `clips?` string[]; `style?` string\|object; `maxWords?` int; `id?` string; `track?` string; `lang?` string

```text
mgl edit video.mgl.json captions.from-speech style=karaoke maxWords=3
{"op":"captions.from-speech","style":"karaoke","maxWords":3}
```

### captions.from-text

Turn a script (text or a file) into caption cues of at most maxWords words, timed to the speech of a voice clip (silences skipped) or spread evenly over clip / at+len.

fields: `text?` string; `file?` string; `clip?` string; `voice?` string; `track?` string; `comp?` string; `style?` string\|object; `id?` string; `maxWords?` int; `at?` time; `len?` time; `words?` boolean; `silenceDb?` number; `minSilence?` number

```text
mgl edit video.mgl.json captions.from-text file=script.txt voice=vo style=karaoke maxWords=4
{"op":"captions.from-text","file":"script.txt","voice":"vo","style":"karaoke","maxWords":4}
```

### captions.import

Import an SRT or WebVTT file as cues (file times are comp times; offset shifts them). Creates a captions clip spanning the cues, or fills `clip` (replacing its cues). Word timings come from VTT inline timestamps; words=true estimates them otherwise.

fields: `file` string (bare word); `clip?` string; `track?` string; `comp?` string; `style?` string\|object; `id?` string; `offset?` time; `words?` boolean

```text
mgl edit video.mgl.json captions.import media/subs.srt style=karaoke words=true
{"op":"captions.import","file":"media/subs.srt","style":"karaoke","words":true}
```

### captions.shift

Shift every cue of a captions clip by `by` (negative = earlier), e.g. to fix subtitles that run late.

fields: `id` string (bare word); `by` time

```text
mgl edit video.mgl.json captions.shift subs by=-0.5s
{"op":"captions.shift","id":"subs","by":"-0.5s"}
```

### captions.style

Style a captions clip: a style id replaces its style, an object merges into it (null removes a field), e.g. style={"highlight": "#00e5ff", "maxWords": 3}.

fields: `id` string (bare word); `style` string\|object

```text
mgl edit video.mgl.json captions.style subs style='{"highlight":"#00e5ff","maxWords":3}'
{"op":"captions.style","id":"subs","style":{"highlight":"#00e5ff","maxWords":3}}
```

### cue.add

Add a cue to a captions clip (at = frames from the clip start); words are per-word start offsets from the cue start (optional).

fields: `clip` string; `at` time; `len` time; `text` string; `words?` time[]; `speaker?` string; `id?` string

```text
mgl edit video.mgl.json cue.add clip=subs at=1s len=1.5s text='Put your phone away'
{"op":"cue.add","clip":"subs","at":"1s","len":"1.5s","text":"Put your phone away"}
```

### cue.merge

Merge consecutive cues of one captions clip into the first (text joined, word times kept).

fields: `ids` string[]

```text
mgl edit video.mgl.json cue.merge ids='["c3","c4"]'
{"op":"cue.merge","ids":["c3","c4"]}
```

### cue.remove

Remove a cue (or several with ids).

fields: `id?` string (bare word); `ids?` string[]

```text
mgl edit video.mgl.json cue.remove c3
{"op":"cue.remove","id":"c3"}
```

### cue.set

Change a cue: text (word times are re-estimated when the word count changes), at, len, words (null removes them), speaker.

fields: `id` string (bare word); `text?` string; `at?` time; `len?` time; `words?` time[]\|null; `speaker?` string\|null

```text
mgl edit video.mgl.json cue.set c3 text='Put your phone in a drawer'
{"op":"cue.set","id":"c3","text":"Put your phone in a drawer"}
```

### cue.split

Split a cue in two: at a time (frames from the cue start; words before it stay) or before word index `word` (0-based).

fields: `id` string (bare word); `at?` time; `word?` int

```text
mgl edit video.mgl.json cue.split c3 word=3
{"op":"cue.split","id":"c3","word":3}
```

## clip

### clip.add

Add a clip: media (asset or src), text, shape, solid colour, nested comp, captions, adjustment or generator. Missing track/at/len are chosen for you: after=<clip> starts it where that clip ends, on that clip's track; with no track a visual clip goes on the topmost free track above any full-frame opaque clip at that time (never hidden under one).

fields: `id?` string; `track?` string; `at?` time; `len?` time; `asset?` string; `text?` string; `shape?` object; `color?` string; `comp?` string; `captions?` true; `adjustment?` true; `gen?` object; `in?` time; `speed?` number\|string; `gain?` number\|keys; `fade?` [time, time]; `muted?` boolean; `loop?` boolean; `fit?` "contain"\|"cover"\|"fill"\|"none"; `crop?` [number, number, number, number]; `style?` string\|object; `animate?` object; `x?` number\|keys; `y?` number\|keys; `anchor?` [number, number]; `scale?` number\|[number, number]\|keys; `rotate?` number\|keys; `opacity?` number\|keys; `blend?` "normal"\|"multiply"\|"screen"\|"overlay"\|"darken"\|"lighten"\|"add"\|"color-dodge"\|"color-burn"\|"hard-light"\|"soft-light"\|"difference"\|"exclusion"\|"hue"\|"saturation"\|"color"\|"luminosity"; `parent?` string; `matte?` object; `remap?` number\|keys; `link?` string; `fx?` object[]; `masks?` object[]; `transition?` object; `clock?` time; `hidden?` boolean; `locked?` boolean; `tags?` string[]; `note?` string; `src?` string; `after?` string

```text
mgl edit video.mgl.json clip.add track=T1 at=2s len=3s text=Hello style=title
{"op":"clip.add","track":"T1","at":"2s","len":"3s","text":"Hello","style":"title"}
```

### clip.detach-audio

Move a video clip's embedded audio to its own clip on an audio track (linked), e.g. for J and L cuts.

fields: `id` string (bare word); `track?` string

```text
mgl edit video.mgl.json clip.detach-audio shotA
{"op":"clip.detach-audio","id":"shotA"}
```

### clip.duplicate

Copy a clip with everything on it (keyframes, effects, masks, transitions, cues of a captions clip): at= its start (default: right after the original, or the same time when track= is given), track= (default: the same track, else a free one), newId=; linked=true also copies its linked clips (same offset, as a new link group).

fields: `id` string (bare word); `at?` time; `track?` string; `newId?` string; `linked?` boolean

```text
mgl edit video.mgl.json clip.duplicate title at=8s
{"op":"clip.duplicate","id":"title","at":"8s"}
```

### clip.freeze

Freeze the frame shown at comp time at= for len= (a held clip is inserted; later clips on the track and its linked tracks ripple; audio is silent during the hold).

fields: `id` string (bare word); `at` time; `len` time; `unlinked?` boolean

```text
mgl edit video.mgl.json clip.freeze run at=3s len=1s
{"op":"clip.freeze","id":"run","at":"3s","len":"1s"}
```

### clip.link

Link clips so edits (move, trim, split, ripple) apply to all of them; ids=[] with link=null unlinks.

fields: `ids` string[]; `link?` string\|null

```text
mgl edit video.mgl.json clip.link ids='["shotA","shotA-audio"]'
{"op":"clip.link","ids":["shotA","shotA-audio"]}
```

### clip.move

Move a clip (and its linked clips) to a new start and/or track.

fields: `id` string (bare word); `at?` time; `by?` time; `track?` string; `unlinked?` boolean

```text
mgl edit video.mgl.json clip.move title at=4s
{"op":"clip.move","id":"title","at":"4s"}
```

### clip.nest

Move clips (with their linked clips, unless unlinked=true) into a new comp and replace them with one clip of that comp (pre-compose).

fields: `ids` string[]; `id?` string; `unlinked?` boolean

```text
mgl edit video.mgl.json clip.nest ids='["badge-bg","badge-text"]' id=badge
{"op":"clip.nest","ids":["badge-bg","badge-text"],"id":"badge"}
```

### clip.punch-in

Zoom a clip into a region (box=[x, y, w, h] in comp px as the clip shows now): writes scale/x/y keyframes that ramp in over len= (default 0.5s; 0 = a hard cut) from at= (comp time; local=true for clip-local frames; default the clip start), hold= (default: to the end), then out= ramps back. ease= (default inOutCubic). The zoom shows the whole box centred and is clamped so no edge of the layer shows when it fills the frame (cover-fit media, nested comps).

fields: `id` string (bare word); `box` [number, number, number, number]; `at?` time; `local?` boolean; `len?` time; `hold?` time; `out?` time; `ease?` easing

```text
mgl edit video.mgl.json clip.punch-in screen box='[1200,600,480,270]' at=3s len=0.6s hold=4s out=0.6s
{"op":"clip.punch-in","id":"screen","box":[1200,600,480,270],"at":"3s","len":"0.6s","hold":"4s","out":"0.6s"}
```

### clip.remove

Remove clips (and their cues); ripple=true closes the gap on their tracks.

fields: `id?` string (bare word); `ids?` string[]; `ripple?` boolean; `unlinked?` boolean

```text
mgl edit video.mgl.json clip.remove shot2 ripple=true
{"op":"clip.remove","id":"shot2","ripple":true}
```

### clip.ripple-delete

Remove a clip and close the gap; all=true shifts every track of the comp (keeps sync).

fields: `id` string (bare word); `all?` boolean; `unlinked?` boolean

```text
mgl edit video.mgl.json clip.ripple-delete shot2
{"op":"clip.ripple-delete","id":"shot2"}
```

### clip.roll

Roll the cut at the END of a clip by= frames: this clip gets longer, the adjacent next clip starts later (total length unchanged).

fields: `id` string (bare word); `by` time; `unlinked?` boolean

```text
mgl edit video.mgl.json clip.roll a by=12
{"op":"clip.roll","id":"a","by":12}
```

### clip.sequence

Place one clip per file (srcs) or asset (assets) back to back on a track from at= (default 0), each len= long (default 2s; full=true plays each file's whole source length, from the probe); on=markers cuts on the markers whose id starts with prefix= (default "beat"), on=beats cuts on the beats of clip=<id>: each item starts on a beat and lasts until the next (the last lasts the median beat interval). Optional fit= and transition={type, len} between items; refuses overlaps.

fields: `srcs?` string[]; `assets?` string[]; `track?` string; `at?` time; `len?` time; `on?` "markers"\|"beats"; `prefix?` string; `clip?` string; `fit?` "contain"\|"cover"\|"fill"\|"none"; `transition?` object; `full?` boolean

```text
mgl edit video.mgl.json clip.sequence srcs='["media/a.mp4","media/b.mp4","media/c.mp4"]' on=markers prefix=beat fit=cover
{"op":"clip.sequence","srcs":["media/a.mp4","media/b.mp4","media/c.mp4"],"on":"markers","prefix":"beat","fit":"cover"}
```

### clip.set

Set clip properties by name or dotted path (y=380, style.color=#ffcc00, fx.blur.radius=8, fx.0.amount=0.5); null resets to the default.

fields: `id` string (bare word)

```text
mgl edit video.mgl.json clip.set title y=380 style.color='#ffcc00'
{"op":"clip.set","id":"title","y":380,"style.color":"#ffcc00"}
```

### clip.slide

Slide a clip by= frames between its neighbours: its content and length stay, the previous clip gets longer/shorter and the next one starts later/earlier.

fields: `id` string (bare word); `by` time; `unlinked?` boolean

```text
mgl edit video.mgl.json clip.slide b by=-6
{"op":"clip.slide","id":"b","by":-6}
```

### clip.slip

Slip: shift which part of the source a media clip shows (by= frames or time; negative = earlier), keeping its place on the timeline.

fields: `id` string (bare word); `by` time; `unlinked?` boolean

```text
mgl edit video.mgl.json clip.slip shot3 by=1s
{"op":"clip.slip","id":"shot3","by":"1s"}
```

### clip.speed

Change playback speed (2 = twice as fast, "3/2"); keeps the same source range (the clip length changes) unless keep=len.

fields: `id` string (bare word); `speed` number\|string; `keep?` "range"\|"len"; `ripple?` boolean; `unlinked?` boolean

```text
mgl edit video.mgl.json clip.speed run speed=2
{"op":"clip.speed","id":"run","speed":2}
```

### clip.split

Split a clip (and its linked clips) at a comp time into two; animations keep their clock, so nothing restarts.

fields: `id` string (bare word); `at` time; `newId?` string; `unlinked?` boolean

```text
mgl edit video.mgl.json clip.split shot1 at=2s
{"op":"clip.split","id":"shot1","at":"2s"}
```

### clip.trim

Trim a clip's head (start=) or tail (end= or len=); content stays in place. ripple=true shifts later clips on the track.

fields: `id` string (bare word); `start?` time; `end?` time; `len?` time; `ripple?` boolean; `unlinked?` boolean

```text
mgl edit video.mgl.json clip.trim shot1 start=0.5s end=3.5s
{"op":"clip.trim","id":"shot1","start":"0.5s","end":"3.5s"}
```

## comp

### comp.add

Add a composition (a timeline): size or preset, fps, length.

fields: `id?` string; `preset?` "shorts"\|"tiktok"\|"reels"\|"vertical"\|"youtube"\|"landscape"\|"square"\|"portrait"\|"4k"; `size?` [int, int]; `fps?` number\|string; `length?` time\|"auto"; `bg?` string; `tracks?` boolean

```text
mgl edit video.mgl.json comp.add id=badge size='[1080,1080]' fps=30 length=5s
{"op":"comp.add","id":"badge","size":[1080,1080],"fps":30,"length":"5s"}
```

### comp.reframe

Resize a comp (or a copy with to=) to another size or preset and re-lay out its clips: media fills the frame, text and shapes keep their relative place inside the frame; track=true follows the main subject.

fields: `id` string (bare word); `size?` [int, int]; `preset?` "shorts"\|"tiktok"\|"reels"\|"vertical"\|"youtube"\|"landscape"\|"square"\|"portrait"\|"4k"; `to?` string; `track?` boolean; `subject?` string

```text
mgl edit video.mgl.json comp.reframe main preset=shorts to=vertical
{"op":"comp.reframe","id":"main","preset":"shorts","to":"vertical"}
```

### comp.remove

Remove a comp with its tracks, clips and markers; refuses while another comp nests it.

fields: `id` string (bare word)

```text
mgl edit video.mgl.json comp.remove badge
{"op":"comp.remove","id":"badge"}
```

### comp.set

Change a comp: size, fps (rescales every time in the comp), length, background.

fields: `id` string (bare word); `size?` [int, int]; `fps?` number\|string; `length?` time\|"auto"\|null; `bg?` string\|null

```text
mgl edit video.mgl.json comp.set main length=30s
{"op":"comp.set","id":"main","length":"30s"}
```

## effects

### fx.add

Add an effect to a clip (id=), or an audio effect to a bus mix (bus=), at= its position in the stack (default last), with its parameters inline. Audio-only effects need a clip with sound; picture-only effects need a visual clip.

fields: `id?` string (bare word); `bus?` string; `type` string; `at?` int

```text
mgl edit video.mgl.json fx.add shot1 type=blur radius=8
{"op":"fx.add","id":"shot1","type":"blur","radius":8}
```

### fx.move

Move an effect to another position in a clip's (id=) or bus's (bus=) effect stack (0 = applied first).

fields: `id?` string (bare word); `bus?` string; `fx` index\|type; `to` int

```text
mgl edit video.mgl.json fx.move shot1 fx=blur to=0
{"op":"fx.move","id":"shot1","fx":"blur","to":0}
```

### fx.remove

Remove an effect from a clip (id=) or a bus (bus=), by index or type.

fields: `id?` string (bare word); `bus?` string; `fx` index\|type

```text
mgl edit video.mgl.json fx.remove shot1 fx=blur
{"op":"fx.remove","id":"shot1","fx":"blur"}
```

### fx.set

Change parameters of a clip's (id=) or bus's (bus=) effect, chosen by index or type (fx=0 or fx=blur); null removes a parameter (back to its default).

fields: `id?` string (bare word); `bus?` string; `fx` index\|type

```text
mgl edit video.mgl.json fx.set shot1 fx=blur radius=12
{"op":"fx.set","id":"shot1","fx":"blur","radius":12}
```

### transition.set

Set the in (from the previous clip, centred on the cut) or out transition of a clip; type=none removes it.

fields: `id` string (bare word); `side?` "in"\|"out"; `type` string; `len?` time; `align?` "center"\|"start"\|"end"

```text
mgl edit video.mgl.json transition.set shot2 type=crossfade len=0.5s
{"op":"transition.set","id":"shot2","type":"crossfade","len":"0.5s"}
```

## project

### id.rename

Rename any entity and update every reference to it (only references to that kind of entity: renaming a clip never touches a bus of the same name).

fields: `id` string (bare word); `to` string

```text
mgl edit video.mgl.json id.rename clip3 to=hook
{"op":"id.rename","id":"clip3","to":"hook"}
```

### project.set

Set project settings: name, platform (safe zones, loudness), main comp, plugins.

fields: `name?` string; `platform?` "shorts"\|"tiktok"\|"reels"\|"youtube"\|"none"; `main?` string; `plugins?` object

```text
mgl edit video.mgl.json project.set name='Focus tips' platform=shorts
{"op":"project.set","name":"Focus tips","platform":"shorts"}
```

## keyframes

### key.clear

Remove all keyframes of a property and set a constant: value=, or the value at frame 0.

fields: `id` string (bare word); `prop` string; `value?` number\|[number, number]\|string\|boolean

```text
mgl edit video.mgl.json key.clear title prop=y value=420
{"op":"key.clear","id":"title","prop":"y","value":420}
```

### key.remove

Remove the keyframe at a clip-local time (abs=true: comp time); one remaining key becomes a constant.

fields: `id` string (bare word); `prop` string; `at` time; `abs?` boolean

```text
mgl edit video.mgl.json key.remove title prop=y at=15
{"op":"key.remove","id":"title","prop":"y","at":15}
```

### key.set

Set a keyframe of a clip property (x, y, scale, rotate, opacity, gain, remap, shape.trim, fx.<index|type>.<param>) at a clip-local time (abs=true: comp time); a constant becomes keyframes.

fields: `id` string (bare word); `prop` string; `at` time; `value` number\|[number, number]\|string\|boolean; `ease?` easing; `abs?` boolean

```text
mgl edit video.mgl.json key.set title prop=y at=0.5s value=420 ease=outCubic
{"op":"key.set","id":"title","prop":"y","at":"0.5s","value":420,"ease":"outCubic"}
```

### key.shift

Shift the keyframes of one property (prop=) or of every property of a clip by a time (negative = earlier).

fields: `id` string (bare word); `prop?` string; `by` time

```text
mgl edit video.mgl.json key.shift title by=0.5s
{"op":"key.shift","id":"title","by":"0.5s"}
```

## layout

### layout.grid

Place clips into the cells of a grid (split screens, 2x2 walls), in reading order: cols=/rows= (default: a near-square grid), gap= px between cells, box=[x, y, w, h] the grid area in comp px (default: the whole frame), fit=cover (default; fills each cell and crops the overflow with a clip-space rect mask) or contain (whole picture, letterboxed in the cell). Sets x, y and scale (media sizes come from the probe); re-running replaces the crop mask.

fields: `ids` string[]; `cols?` int; `rows?` int; `gap?` number; `box?` [number, number, number, number]; `fit?` "cover"\|"contain"

```text
mgl edit video.mgl.json layout.grid ids='["camA","camB"]' cols=1 gap=8
{"op":"layout.grid","ids":["camA","camB"],"cols":1,"gap":8}
```

## marker

### marker.add

Add a marker (a named point or range) to a comp.

fields: `at` time; `id?` string; `comp?` string; `len?` time; `note?` string

```text
mgl edit video.mgl.json marker.add at=15s id=drop note='beat drop'
{"op":"marker.add","at":"15s","id":"drop","note":"beat drop"}
```

### marker.beats

Add a marker on every beat of a clip's audio (music, or a video with sound), inside the part of the source the clip plays: ids <prefix>1, <prefix>2, ... (re-running replaces them); every=n keeps every nth beat, max= caps the count, min= requires at least that many.

fields: `clip` string (bare word); `prefix?` string; `min?` int; `max?` int; `every?` int

```text
mgl edit video.mgl.json marker.beats bed every=2 max=16
{"op":"marker.beats","clip":"bed","every":2,"max":16}
```

### marker.remove

Remove a marker.

fields: `id` string (bare word)

```text
mgl edit video.mgl.json marker.remove drop
{"op":"marker.remove","id":"drop"}
```

## masks

### mask.add

Add a mask (rect, ellipse or SVG path) that cuts a clip; box is [x, y, w, h] in comp px, or clip fractions with space=clip; an animated box is keyframes [[frame, [x, y, w, h], easing?], ...] (clip-local frames).

fields: `id` string (bare word); `shape` "rect"\|"ellipse"\|"path"; `box?` [number, number, number, number]\|keys\|null; `d?` string\|null; `space?` "comp"\|"clip"\|null; `feather?` number\|null; `radius?` number\|null; `invert?` boolean\|null; `mode?` "add"\|"subtract"\|"intersect"\|null; `opacity?` number\|null

```text
mgl edit video.mgl.json mask.add shot1 shape=ellipse box='[140,560,800,800]' feather=40
{"op":"mask.add","id":"shot1","shape":"ellipse","box":[140,560,800,800],"feather":40}
```

### mask.remove

Remove a clip's mask (by index).

fields: `id` string (bare word); `mask` int

```text
mgl edit video.mgl.json mask.remove shot1 mask=0
{"op":"mask.remove","id":"shot1","mask":0}
```

### mask.set

Change a clip's mask (by index); null removes a field.

fields: `id` string (bare word); `mask` int; `shape?` "rect"\|"ellipse"\|"path"; `box?` [number, number, number, number]\|keys\|null; `d?` string\|null; `space?` "comp"\|"clip"\|null; `feather?` number\|null; `radius?` number\|null; `invert?` boolean\|null; `mode?` "add"\|"subtract"\|"intersect"\|null; `opacity?` number\|null

```text
mgl edit video.mgl.json mask.set shot1 mask=0 feather=80 invert=true
{"op":"mask.set","id":"shot1","mask":0,"feather":80,"invert":true}
```

### matte.set

Show a clip only through another clip's alpha or luma (track matte); clip=null removes it. The matte clip is hidden unless keep=true.

fields: `id` string (bare word); `clip` string\|null; `mode?` "alpha"\|"luma"\|"alpha-inverted"\|"luma-inverted"; `keep?` boolean

```text
mgl edit video.mgl.json matte.set shot1 clip=title mode=alpha
{"op":"matte.set","id":"shot1","clip":"title","mode":"alpha"}
```

## motion

### motion.apply

Animate clips with motion presets: in= (from the clip start), out= (ending on its last frame), emphasis= (one or a list, "pulse@2s" = clip-local start; default mid-clip), loop= (repeats seamlessly between the in and out on the same properties; ken-burns-* run once across it). len= sets in/out/emphasis length, period= a loop cycle, stagger= the delay between ids= (in and emphasis), params= preset params ({amount: 1.5, offscreen: true, "in.distance": 300}). Writes plain keyframes relative to the rest values, merged with existing keys; re-applying a phase replaces it. Presets: in= fade|pop|slide-up|slide-down|slide-left|slide-right|zoom|focus|drop|spin|whip; out= fade|pop|slide-up|slide-down|slide-left|slide-right|zoom|focus|drop|spin|whip; emphasis= pulse|punch|shake|wiggle|bounce|nod|flash|tada; loop= float|breathe|sway|spin|drift|ken-burns-in|ken-burns-out.

fields: `id?` string (bare word); `ids?` string[]; `in?` string; `out?` string; `emphasis?` string\|string[]; `loop?` string; `len?` time; `period?` time; `stagger?` time; `params?` object

```text
mgl edit video.mgl.json motion.apply title in=pop out=fade emphasis=pulse@1.5s loop=float
{"op":"motion.apply","id":"title","in":"pop","out":"fade","emphasis":"pulse@1.5s","loop":"float"}
```

### motion.clear

Remove the keyframes motion.apply wrote on a clip: every phase, or phase=in|out|emphasis|loop; properties go back to their rest values (other keys are kept).

fields: `id` string (bare word); `phase?` "in"\|"out"\|"emphasis"\|"loop"\|"all"

```text
mgl edit video.mgl.json motion.clear title phase=loop
{"op":"motion.clear","id":"title","phase":"loop"}
```

## recipes

### recipe.short

Build a finished vertical Short in one call from a script (text or file): moving backgrounds per sentence (b-roll with ken-burns and punch-ins, or animated generators), a hook title, word-highlighted captions timed to the voice-over (a recording via vo=, or speech made from the script via voice= with a speak plugin; else reading speed), a progress bar, a CTA, music with ducking, platform loudness and rotating transitions. Needs an empty comp (mgl new shorts --script s.txt runs it).

fields: `script` string · the narration: text, or a path to a .txt/.md file (relative to the project) (bare word); `vo?` string · voice-over: a clip id, an asset id or a file path; captions follow its speech; `voice?` true\|string · speak the script with the project's speak provider (a plugin, e.g. flite-voice): true = its default voice, or a voice id; captions follow the word timings; `media?` string[] · b-roll videos/images, cycled every ~2-3 s with ken-burns and punch-ins; `style?` "clean"\|"bold"\|"viral" · clean \| bold \| viral (default viral); `len?` time · total length (default: the voice-over, or the script at reading speed, plus the CTA); `music?` boolean\|string · true (default): a generated bed when the audio.music command exists; a path: that file; false: none; `captions?` boolean; `hook?` boolean; `cta?` string\|false · the end call-to-action label (default "Follow for more"); false: none; `platform?` "shorts"\|"tiktok"\|"reels"\|"youtube"\|"none"; `seed?` int · varies palettes, transitions and media order (default 0); `comp?` string

```text
mgl edit video.mgl.json recipe.short 'Most people waste their mornings. Here are three habits that changed mine. Try them for a week.' style=viral cta='Follow for more'
{"op":"recipe.short","script":"Most people waste their mornings. Here are three habits that changed mine. Try them for a week.","style":"viral","cta":"Follow for more"}
```

## text

### style.add

Add a named text style to the project (any TextStyle field; base inherits from another style, e.g. base=caption). Clips use it with style=<id>.

fields: `id` string (bare word); `font?` string; `size?` number; `weight?` number\|"normal"\|"bold"; `italic?` boolean; `color?` string; `align?` "left"\|"center"\|"right"; `lineHeight?` number; `letterSpacing?` number; `stroke?` string; `strokeWidth?` number; `shadow?` string; `shadowBlur?` number; `shadowOffset?` [number, number]; `bg?` string; `bgPadding?` number\|[number, number]; `bgRadius?` number; `maxWidth?` number; `uppercase?` boolean; `highlight?` string; `emphasisColor?` string; `maxWords?` int; `maxLines?` int; `box?` [number, number]; `base?` string

```text
mgl edit video.mgl.json style.add brand base=caption color='#00e5ff' font=Inter size=70
{"op":"style.add","id":"brand","base":"caption","color":"#00e5ff","font":"Inter","size":70}
```

### style.remove

Remove a project style; refuses while a clip or another style uses it.

fields: `id` string (bare word)

```text
mgl edit video.mgl.json style.remove brand
{"op":"style.remove","id":"brand"}
```

### style.set

Change fields of a project style; null removes a field (it then inherits from base or the defaults).

fields: `font?` string\|null; `size?` number\|null; `weight?` number\|"normal"\|"bold"\|null; `italic?` boolean\|null; `color?` string\|null; `align?` "left"\|"center"\|"right"\|null; `lineHeight?` number\|null; `letterSpacing?` number\|null; `stroke?` string\|null; `strokeWidth?` number\|null; `shadow?` string\|null; `shadowBlur?` number\|null; `shadowOffset?` [number, number]\|null; `bg?` string\|null; `bgPadding?` number\|[number, number]\|null; `bgRadius?` number\|null; `maxWidth?` number\|null; `uppercase?` boolean\|null; `highlight?` string\|null; `emphasisColor?` string\|null; `maxWords?` int\|null; `maxLines?` int\|null; `box?` [number, number]\|null; `base?` string\|null; `id` string (bare word)

```text
mgl edit video.mgl.json style.set brand color='#ffcc00' stroke=null
{"op":"style.set","id":"brand","color":"#ffcc00","stroke":null}
```

### text.animate

Animate a text clip per char / word / line / all with in and out presets (fade, pop, slide-up, slide-down, slide-left, typewriter, blur-in, bounce, scale-in, drop, wave, none); stagger and len are frames per unit; null removes a field.

fields: `id` string (bare word); `in?` string\|null; `out?` string\|null; `by?` "char"\|"word"\|"line"\|"all"\|null; `stagger?` time\|null; `len?` time\|null

```text
mgl edit video.mgl.json text.animate title in=pop by=word stagger=3
{"op":"text.animate","id":"title","in":"pop","by":"word","stagger":3}
```

### text.set

Change the text of a text clip or a caption cue; a cue's word times are re-estimated unless keepWords=true and the word count is unchanged.

fields: `id` string (bare word); `text` string; `keepWords?` boolean

```text
mgl edit video.mgl.json text.set title text='Three tips to focus'
{"op":"text.set","id":"title","text":"Three tips to focus"}
```

## templates

### template.apply

Insert a template (intro, lower-third, cta, title, end-card, progress-bar, quote, listicle-item, or a plugin's) at a time; its layers go on free visual tracks above existing content, ids are prefixed, clips are tagged "template:<id>". Pass template parameters in `params`.

fields: `template` string (bare word); `at?` time; `len?` time; `track?` string; `comp?` string; `prefix?` string; `params?` object

```text
mgl edit video.mgl.json template.apply lower-third at=2s params='{"name":"Ada Lovelace","role":"Engineer"}'
{"op":"template.apply","template":"lower-third","at":"2s","params":{"name":"Ada Lovelace","role":"Engineer"}}
```

## track

### track.add

Add a track to a comp; visual tracks stack in order (later = on top), audio tracks mix into a bus.

fields: `id?` string (bare word); `comp?` string; `audio?` boolean; `bus?` string; `below?` string; `above?` string

```text
mgl edit video.mgl.json track.add V2
{"op":"track.add","id":"V2"}
```

### track.move

Change a track's stacking position (below/above another track, or to top/bottom).

fields: `id` string (bare word); `below?` string; `above?` string; `to?` "top"\|"bottom"

```text
mgl edit video.mgl.json track.move T1 to=top
{"op":"track.move","id":"T1","to":"top"}
```

### track.remove

Remove a track and its clips.

fields: `id` string (bare word)

```text
mgl edit video.mgl.json track.remove V3
{"op":"track.remove","id":"V3"}
```

### track.set

Change a track: hidden, muted, locked, bus.

fields: `id` string (bare word); `hidden?` boolean; `muted?` boolean; `locked?` boolean; `bus?` string\|null; `note?` string

```text
mgl edit video.mgl.json track.set A2 bus=music
{"op":"track.set","id":"A2","bus":"music"}
```
